data.name: Yagnyav
data.gender_notes: Yagnyav is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Yagnyav is recorded with the meaning “Offering to the fire”. Yagnyav is a Sanskrit name meaning “Offering to the fire”. in_sanskrit.name: यज्ञव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who offers yajna, a spiritual ritual of making offerings to fire, to connect with the divine.

in_hindi.name: यज्ञव
in_hindi.long_meaning: जो अग्नि में यज्ञ का अर्पण करता है, संबंध के लिए दिव्य से जुड़ने के लिए।

in_tamil.name: யஜ்ஞவ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: அக்னியில் யாகம் கொடுத்தவன், தெய்வம் சம்பந்தித்துக் கொள்ளும் புனித அறவு.

in_telugu.name: యజ్ఞవ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: అగ్ని లో యజ్ఞ ప్రదానం చేయడానికి, దివ్య సంబంధం స్థాపించడం.

in_marathi.name: Yagnyav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Offering to the fire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yagnyav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the word 'yajna', Yagnyav signifies one who performs yajna or offering to the fire in Hindu rituals.

in_bengali.name: Yagnyav
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Offering to the fire
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yagnyav একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the word 'yajna', Yagnyav signifies one who performs yajna or offering to the fire in Hindu rituals.
